name: 7Days
source: A number of dead spirits have been assigned to an interactive fiction test. Successfully completing the interactive story test ensures they will be resurrected. The messenger of death has assigned them each a task. They must attack one another or work together to solve mystery and complete their tasks. Your character, Kirell, must also complete the choice based games task she has been assigned. But her tasks requires her to be the decision maker for others die.
translation: 一群亡靈被安排參加一場互動故事試煉。只要順利完成試煉，就能復活。死神的使者為每個人分配了任務。他們必須互相攻擊，或攜手合作，破解謎團，完成各自的任務。你扮演的奇睿爾，也必須透過選擇完成自己的試煉。可她的任務，卻要求她決定其他人的死亡。
